brief:
Eye on Palestine documented a young girl named Manal accompanying her mother, Samia, as she navigates the streets of Gaza using crutches. The image captures the child walking beside her mother in what the outlet describes as steps "filled with love."

The report offers a glimpse of daily life in Gaza, where residents continue ordinary routines amid the territory's ongoing hardships.
dek: With steady steps filled with love, little Manal accompanies her mother, Samia, who walks with crutches through the streets of Gaza.
title: Girl guides mother on crutches through Gaza streets
